subject: Stakeholder onboarding — request to reschedule demo
messages:
From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acmehealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Reynolds <mark.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — full walkthrough + additional stakeholders

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the overview yesterday. We are excited to see Redwood in action. The team here would like a full demo that includes our security, infra, and procurement stakeholders so everyone understands the data flow and contractual pieces.

Proposed time: Tue, Apr 6 at 10:00 AM PT — does that work for your side? If not, we can shift.

I've attached a short requirements summary so you can tailor the walkthrough (acme-requirements-summary.pdf).

Attendees from our side: Sarah Jones (Product), Mark Reynolds (Infra), procurement@acmehealth.com (procurement team) — procurement lead may be remote that week.

Looking forward — please let me know availability and any pre-reads you want.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Jones
Director, Product
Acme Health


From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — full walkthrough + additional stakeholders

Hi Sarah — great, thanks for the context and the attachment.

We can absolutely do a full walkthrough that covers security/compliance, infra integration, and procurement questions. Ben will lead the demo; Laura will handle security/compliance controls, and Hiro will cover infra and deployment patterns.

Quick ask: can you confirm the procurement lead's timezone and whether they need a redlined commercial slide? If procurement wants contract-level detail we can block extra time.

Alternate slots we have open if Apr 6 conflicts:
- Wed, Apr 7: 9:00–10:30 AM PT
- Thu, Apr 8: 1:00–2:30 PM PT
- Tue, Apr 13: 11:00 AM–12:30 PM PT

If procurement needs a separate commercial/contract session we can do that right after the demo or schedule a follow-up with our sales ops. I've looped in Ben, Laura, and Hiro.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: MAP-AcmeHealth-v1.docx (draft mutual action plan, will share updated link after we confirm time)

Thanks, Olga — quick update: our procurement lead (Monica Alvarez) is traveling Apr 5–8 and confirmed she needs to be on the same call for any contract-level discussion. Security also requested a deeper dive into network segmentation and key management (they asked to see our suggested KMS flows).

Because of Monica's travel, Apr 6/7/8 won't work for a complete, single-session demo + procurement discussion. Would you be able to look at the week of Apr 12? Our preferred windows that week are:
- Tue, Apr 13: 11:00–1:00 PM PT
- Wed, Apr 14: 9:00–11:00 AM PT
- Thu, Apr 15: 2:00–4:00 PM PT

If needed, we can do the technical demo first and schedule a short separate contract session with Monica the following week, but they'd prefer to have procurement on the main call.

Apologies for the churn — travel and an internal reorganization added these folks last-minute.

Best,
Sarah

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and for flagging Monica's travel. Totally understand wanting procurement in the main session.

We can tentatively hold Tue Apr 13 11:00 AM–12:30 PM PT for the combined walkthrough + procurement Q&A. I'll include an agenda and a short mutual action plan (MAP) in advance — see attached draft. If that slot works, please confirm attendees and whether Monica prefers a calendar invite to include a DocuSign placeholder.

Proposed agenda (90 min):
1) 0–10 min: introductions and goals
2) 10–50 min: technical demo (infra & security deep-dive) — Hiro + Laura
3) 50–70 min: procurement & commercial overview — Ben
4) 70–90 min: live Q&A and next steps / MAP review

Attachments: MAP-AcmeHealth-v1.docx (draft)
Deal ID: ACME-2027-001
